records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:38 — update unconditionally rewrites visible from params, so any request omitting visible silently sets it false and flips the group's guardian visibility
records.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#update, the diff sets `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` unconditionally. If a request omits `visible` (or still sends it nested under `group[visible]` from the old API), `params[:visible]` will be nil and this will set `visible` to false, potentially flipping a group’s visibility unintentionally.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:11 — New pagination computed properties ship with no JS unit or acceptance test; `totalPages` is off by one for exact multiples (50 members at limit 50 renders "1/2").
records.rationale: In admin-group.js.es6 `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which is off by one when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). This is verifiable from the diff. The note about missing JS tests is also grounded (diff adds pagination logic but includes no JS tests), but the off-by-one is a concrete correctness bug.
